title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Budget)
(1) The Government shall appropriate in its budget the amount necessary to pay for private investments to be acquired under the preceding Article. Provided, however, that the budget may be adjusted within the amount of dividends that the Government expects to receive from the Industrial Bank of Korea.
(2) The term "necessary amount" in the preceding paragraph means the aggregate amount of private investments for which applications for acquisition have been submitted to the Financial Services Commission no later than seven months before the commencement of the Government's fiscal year. [Amended on February 29, 2008.]
